wolffsmodnpcs.tuning.steering_response.h: 0 keeps immediate steering. Otherwise 1–100 ticks builds from zero to the maximum turn rate; reversing steering direction takes longer. Physical yaw and rolling-radius limits still apply. Reset on idle. Requires driving.
wolffsmodnpcs.tuning.stationary_turn.hel: Default allows tracked vehicles to turn in place. Require rolling applies the rolling-radius limit even to tracked vehicles, including recovery. Wheeled vehicles always need to roll. No legacy crawl-pivot maneuver is added. Requires driving.
wolffsmodnpcs.tuning.traffic_stop_gap.he: 0 keeps half the following distance. Otherwise 1–320 sets a 0.1–32 block edge-to-edge gap where traffic requests zero throttle. Capped at following distance; following distance 0 disables traffic checks. This is a braking threshold, not guaranteed final separation: braking takes time and traffic is sampled every 10 ticks. Recovery does not check traffic.
wolffsmodnpcs.creation_faction.unknown: Unknown NPC faction. Choose an existing Custom NPCs faction.
wolffsmodnpcs.creation_faction.set: NPCs you create with tools or commands will now use faction %s.

wolffsmodnpcs.remote.radius.help: Maximum distance in blocks, measured in all directions at scan time. Click to cycle. Results are nearest first. All includes loaded NPCs in this dimension.
wolffsmodnpcs.remote.refresh.help: Scan again from your current position. Keeps the radius, faction and name filters.
wolffsmodnpcs.weapons.advanced_search_in: Use the six independent band intervals below. Off by default: near/far interpolation is retained. Each band accepts 1–1200 ticks; 0 keeps its calculated interval. Requires Progressive target search.
wolffsmodnpcs.weapons.stagger_near_searc: Disable shared timing for the first 32 blocks and give each NPC its own search phase, including its first search. Off by default: nearby searches remain synchronized. Independent of Advanced search intervals; requires Progressive target search. This can spread work but delay an individual reaction.
wolffsmodnpcs.tuning.search_band_0_inter: Ticks between target searches in the 0–32 block band, capped by aggro range. 1–1200; 0 uses this band’s near/far interpolation. Only active with Advanced search intervals and Progressive target search. Shorter intervals react sooner but search more often.
wolffsmodnpcs.tuning.search_band_1_inter: Ticks between target searches in the 32–64 block band, capped by aggro range. 1–1200; 0 uses this band’s near/far interpolation. Only active with Advanced search intervals and Progressive target search. Shorter intervals react sooner but search more often.
wolffsmodnpcs.tuning.search_band_2_inter: Ticks between target searches in the 64–128 block band, capped by aggro range. 1–1200; 0 uses this band’s near/far interpolation. Only active with Advanced search intervals and Progressive target search. Shorter intervals react sooner but search more often.
wolffsmodnpcs.tuning.search_band_3_inter: Ticks between target searches in the 128–256 block band, capped by aggro range. 1–1200; 0 uses this band’s near/far interpolation. Only active with Advanced search intervals and Progressive target search. Shorter intervals react sooner but search more often.
wolffsmodnpcs.tuning.search_band_4_inter: Ticks between target searches in the 256–384 block band, capped by aggro range. 1–1200; 0 uses this band’s near/far interpolation. Only active with Advanced search intervals and Progressive target search. Shorter intervals react sooner but search more often.
wolffsmodnpcs.tuning.search_band_5_inter: Ticks between target searches in the 384–512 block band, capped by aggro range. 1–1200; 0 uses this band’s near/far interpolation. Only active with Advanced search intervals and Progressive target search. Shorter intervals react sooner but search more often.
wolffsmodnpcs.tuning.handling_mode.help: Inherit reads the selected model's compatible handling values, or the documented fallback if unavailable. Custom starts from the effective value rounded to the existing integer editor units. Switching to Inherit clears this numeric override. Saved positive values remain Custom. Driver policy and actual driven Flan vehicles are unchanged.
wolffsmodnpcs.weapons.return_home_telepo: Yes keeps Custom NPCs automatic teleport recovery when returning home. No requires physical travel and retries a finished or failed path at most every 40 game ticks (about 2 seconds). An unreachable NPC can remain stranded. Requires Custom NPCs Return to start; does not affect scripted teleports.

commands.wolffsmodnpcs.server.ranges_app: Every NPC now takes aggro range %s and firing range %s: loaded NPCs within a second, the others when they next load.

wolffsmodnpcs.combat.armor_properties.su: Inherit, keep or import each armor value
wolffsmodnpcs.combat.projectile_slot_pro: Inherit or override native throw speed; import the item default
wolffsmodnpcs.combat.equipment.native_th: Inherit: the projectile-slot item's default launch speed. Custom: a decimal override from 0.01 to 10 blocks per tick, used for both aiming and launch. Import copies the item's unmodified default, even while an override is active. Applies to potions, experience bottles, eggs and fireworks. Fire charges keep their powered flight.
wolffsmodnpcs.combat.equipment_group.nat: Real throwables in the Projectile slot, independently of weapons in hand. Needs Native throwables. Inherit is the default; Custom and Import preserve fractional speeds such as 0.75.
wolffsmodnpcs.combat.equipment_off.nativ: Native throwables is off: Custom NPCs handles the Projectile slot; this speed override is inactive.
wolffsmodnpcs.tuning.take_driveables.hel: Which free driveables the NPC gets into. Its side's: those no player owns, and those whose owner is about and on its side: the player it follows, one on its Teams team, or one its faction is friendly to. Any free one: any that no enemy of it rides. Nobody's: only those no player owns. A player owns the driveables they placed or first locked with a key; one locked with a key is never taken.
wolffsmodnpcs.weapons.read_only.native_t: The native throwable's effective speed, shown on the Custom NPCs scale (10 = 1 block/tick). Edit Inherit/Custom and import the exact item default under Wolff's Mod > Projectiles > Projectile slot properties.
wolffsmodnpcs.combat.equipment.armor_bre: Inherit: a worn Flan armor piece with water breathing keeps the NPC's air full. Custom: only the NPC's own Can drown setting counts. Import copies whether the armor grants it.
wolffsmodnpcs.combat.equipment.armor_exp: Inherit: armor points, toughness, Protection and Blast Protection enchantments and Flan armor defense reduce explosions. Custom: the NPC's explosion resistance. Shown at a ten-HP hit. Other damage armor stops is always reduced by the armor.
wolffsmodnpcs.combat.equipment.armor_fal: Inherit: a worn Flan armor piece that negates fall damage protects the NPC from it. Custom: only the NPC's own No fall damage setting counts. Import copies whether the armor grants it.
wolffsmodnpcs.combat.equipment.armor_fir: Inherit: a worn Flan armor piece with fire resistance makes the NPC immune to fire and lava. Custom: only the NPC's own fire immunity counts. Import copies whether the armor grants it.
wolffsmodnpcs.combat.equipment.armor_kno: Inherit: the worn armor's knockback resistance attribute. Custom: the NPC's knockback resistance.
wolffsmodnpcs.combat.equipment.armor_mel: Inherit: armor points, toughness, Protection enchantments and Flan armor defense reduce melee hits. Custom: the NPC's melee resistance. Shown at a ten-HP hit.
wolffsmodnpcs.combat.equipment.armor_pro: Inherit: armor points, toughness, Protection enchantments, Flan armor defense and Flan bullet defense reduce projectile hits. Custom: the NPC's projectile resistance. Shown at a ten-HP hit.
wolffsmodnpcs.combat.equipment.firing_bl: The sound the round makes when it hits a block: the Flan ammunition's, the struck block's material, or the vanilla arrow and trident sounds. A material sound cannot be imported.
wolffsmodnpcs.combat.equipment.firing_bu: Shots per burst: a Flan gun's magazine, or one shot for a slow weapon or a single round. Import it for when Use equipped weapons is off.
Ticks between the shots of a burst: a Flan gun's shot delay. Import it for when Use equipped weapons is off.
wolffsmodnpcs.combat.equipment.firing_de: Ticks between bursts: a Flan gun's reload time, or the item's shot delay plus its draw or charge time. The item always times its own shots; import it for when Use equipped weapons is off.
wolffsmodnpcs.combat.equipment.firing_en: The sound the round makes when it hits a creature: the Flan ammunition's hit sound, or the vanilla arrow and trident sounds. Import it for when Use equipped weapons is off.
wolffsmodnpcs.combat.equipment.firing_so: Inherit: the Flan gun's own shooting sound, while Flan firing sounds are on. Custom: the NPC's firing sound. Bows, crossbows and thrown items always play their own.
wolffsmodnpcs.combat.equipment.melee_dam: Inherit: the striking weapon's attack damage and enchantment bonus against the target. Custom: the NPC's melee strength, shared by both hands. Melee dual wield never combines the two weapons' damage.
wolffsmodnpcs.combat.equipment.melee_del: Inherit: ticks between hits from the item's attack speed, or a Flan weapon's melee time. Custom: the NPC's melee speed.
wolffsmodnpcs.combat.equipment.melee_eff: Inherit: the item's own hit effects, as for a player: Fire Aspect, other enchantments and item hit effects. Custom: the NPC's melee effect, a potion effect or fire. Import copies Fire Aspect as fire.
wolffsmodnpcs.combat.equipment.melee_kno: Inherit: the item's knockback attribute plus its Knockback enchantment. Custom: the NPC's melee knockback, pushed as Custom NPCs pushes.
wolffsmodnpcs.combat.equipment.melee_rea: Inherit: the item's reach attribute, 3 blocks by default. Custom: the NPC's melee range.
wolffsmodnpcs.combat.equipment.off_hand_: Inherit: the off-hand gun's spread, with attachments and stance. Custom: the NPC's accuracy, shared with the main hand.
Inherit: the off-hand gun's damage. Custom: the NPC's projectile strength, the same value a main-hand weapon kept as Custom fires with; ammunition still modifies it.
Ticks the off-hand gun takes to reload from the projectile slot. The gun always keeps its own.
Inherit: rounds per shot from the off-hand gun and its ammunition. Custom: the NPC's shot count, from 1 to 10, shared with the main hand.
Ticks between the off-hand gun's shots. The gun always keeps its own cadence; Custom NPCs has no field for a second gun's.
Inherit: the off-hand gun's shooting sound, while Flan firing sounds are on. Custom: the NPC's firing sound.
Inherit: the off-hand gun's launch speed. Custom: the NPC's projectile speed, shared with the main hand. Ammunition that declares its own muzzle velocity keeps it either way.
wolffsmodnpcs.combat.equipment.projectil: Explosion radius of the round. Import gives the nearest Custom NPCs size: small below 2 blocks, medium below 4, large above.
Whether the round drops. Equipped weapons always fire their real rounds; import it for when Use equipped weapons is off.
Share of vanilla knockback the round keeps (1x is vanilla). Custom NPCs counts projectile knockback in punch levels instead, so it cannot be imported.
Width of the round's hitbox in blocks. Custom NPCs projectile size only scales how the projectile is drawn, so it cannot be imported.
wolffsmodnpcs.combat.equipment.ranged_ac: Inherit: the weapon's spread, with attachments and stance. Custom: the NPC's accuracy, which ammunition still modifies on a Flan gun. Applies to guns, bows, crossbows and thrown items.
wolffsmodnpcs.combat.equipment.ranged_da: Inherit: the weapon's damage. Custom: the NPC's projectile strength, which ammunition still modifies on a Flan gun. Applies to guns and bows; grenades, throwable guns and other thrown items keep their own damage.
wolffsmodnpcs.combat.equipment.ranged_sh: Inherit: rounds per shot from the Flan gun and its ammunition, such as shotgun pellets. Custom: the NPC's shot count, from 1 to 10. Applies to Flan guns only.
wolffsmodnpcs.combat.equipment.ranged_sp: Inherit: the weapon's launch speed. Custom: the NPC's projectile speed. Ammunition that declares its own muzzle velocity keeps it either way. Applies to guns, bows, crossbows and thrown items.
wolffsmodnpcs.combat.equipment.shield_ab: Share of a frontal hit's damage the shield absorbs, for hits it cannot block outright, such as bullets.
wolffsmodnpcs.combat.equipment.shield_bl: Chance that the shield blocks a frontal melee hit or thrown weapon entirely.
wolffsmodnpcs.combat.equipment.shield_ki: A vanilla shield is raised whenever the NPC has a target and stops every hit from the front. A Flan shield protects while held, by the values below. Needs Use equipped weapons; a shield in the main hand works the same way.
wolffsmodnpcs.combat.equipment.shield_ma: Strongest melee hit, in damage points, the shield can still block. A stronger hit goes through.
wolffsmodnpcs.combat.equipment_copy.help: Copy the slot's current values into the NPC's own values now. They serve while Use equipped weapons is off.
wolffsmodnpcs.combat.equipment_group.arm: Protection of the worn armor against each kind of hit
Fire, water and fall protection of worn Flan armor
wolffsmodnpcs.combat.equipment_group.fir: Sounds and firing rhythm of the ranged weapon
wolffsmodnpcs.combat.equipment_group.mel: Melee statistics: main hand by default; with Melee dual wield, Inherit reads the striking weapon and Custom is shared. Readouts compare both weapons; Copy/Import still takes the main hand.
wolffsmodnpcs.combat.equipment_group.off: A Flan gun in the off hand, fired beside a ranged main-hand weapon with Dual wield, or on its own when the main hand holds no ranged weapon
A shield in the off hand: a vanilla shield the NPC raises to block, or a Flan shield that protects while held
wolffsmodnpcs.combat.equipment_group.pro: How the round the ranged weapon fires flies and hits
wolffsmodnpcs.combat.equipment_group.ran: Statistics of the ranged weapon the NPC fires: the main-hand weapon, an off-hand Flan gun, or a throwable in the projectile slot
wolffsmodnpcs.combat.equipment_import.he: Copy the slot's current value into the NPC's own value now, replacing the value shown.
wolffsmodnpcs.combat.equipment_import_al: Copy every value the slots offer on this tab into the NPC's own values now and switch them to Custom.
wolffsmodnpcs.combat.equipment_inherit_a: Switch every statistic on this tab back to Inherit. The NPC keeps its own values saved for later.
wolffsmodnpcs.combat.equipment_mode.help: Inherit takes this statistic from the slot while its Use equipped switch is on; its value is read-only here and in the standard editor. Custom uses the NPC's own value, which you edit here or in the standard editor.
wolffsmodnpcs.combat.equipment_off.item_: Use equipped armor is off: the NPC uses its own values.
Use equipped weapons is off: the NPC uses its own values.
wolffsmodnpcs.combat.equipment_value.inh: Slot value in use. Switch to Custom to set your own.
wolffsmodnpcs.combat.equipment_value.mod: The NPC's own value, currently set by the selected model. Switch that property to Custom in Inherit from model > Model properties to edit it.
wolffsmodnpcs.combat.equipment_value.own: The NPC's own melee effect, edited in Stats > Melee properties.
wolffsmodnpcs.combat.import.help: Copy the model's value into the NPC's own value now, replacing the value shown.
wolffsmodnpcs.combat.import_all.help: Copy every value the model offers on this tab into the NPC's own values now and switch them to Custom.
wolffsmodnpcs.combat.import_hint: Hover labels and buttons for help. Changes are sent when you leave this tab.
wolffsmodnpcs.combat.inherit_all.help: Switch every value the model offers on this tab back to Inherit. The NPC keeps its own values saved for later.
wolffsmodnpcs.combat.knockback.help: By model makes the NPC immune to knockback while it looks like an AA gun, mecha, plane or vehicle. Immune and Normal apply whatever the model. Explosions still push, as they push other heavy mobs.
wolffsmodnpcs.combat.main_hand_propertie: Inherit, keep or import each main-hand value
wolffsmodnpcs.combat.minimum_hit.help: Hits of this kind weaker than this damage are ignored; a hit of exactly this damage counts. 0 accepts every hit. Compared with the incoming damage before armor and resistances, after the model damage profile.
wolffsmodnpcs.combat.mode.engine.help: Inherit plays the model's engine sounds; Custom plays the NPC's own. Shared by both engine rows and by Sounds > Idle & movement.
wolffsmodnpcs.combat.mode.help: Inherit follows the selected model; its value is read-only here and in the standard editor. Custom uses the NPC's own value, which you edit here or in the standard editor.
wolffsmodnpcs.combat.mode.item.help: The item always decides this while Use equipped weapons is on. Import copies it into the NPC's own values, which serve when the switch is off.
wolffsmodnpcs.combat.muted.fire_sounds: Flan firing sounds is off (Sounds > Weapon), so the model's firing sound is not used: the NPC plays its own.
wolffsmodnpcs.combat.muted.item_fire_sou: Silent: Flan firing sounds is off (Sounds > Weapon), so the Flan gun does not play its shot. Switch to Custom to play the NPC's own firing sound.
wolffsmodnpcs.combat.muted.model_sounds: Model idle and step sounds is off (Sounds > Idle & movement), so the model's sound is not used: the NPC plays its own.
wolffsmodnpcs.combat.no_model: The selected model offers no properties. Select a Flan model first.
wolffsmodnpcs.combat.off_hand_properties: Inherit, keep or import each off-hand value
wolffsmodnpcs.combat.parts.summary: Box, hit points, resistance and armour of each part
wolffsmodnpcs.combat.parts_hint: Sizes are in model pixels (1/16 block). Changes apply when you leave this tab.
wolffsmodnpcs.combat.properties.summary: Inherit, keep or import each model value
wolffsmodnpcs.combat.properties_disabled: Turn on Use model properties to inherit the model's values and weapon stats.
wolffsmodnpcs.combat.property.engine_idl: The engine sound while the vehicle stands still. The same setting as Sounds > Idle & movement: a change in one shows in the other.
wolffsmodnpcs.combat.property.engine_mov: The engine sound while the vehicle moves. The same setting as Sounds > Idle & movement: a change in one shows in the other.
wolffsmodnpcs.combat.select.help: Choose a sound from the list. The chosen sound becomes the NPC's own, and the row switches to Custom.
wolffsmodnpcs.combat.value.inherited: Model value in use. Switch to Custom to set your own.
wolffsmodnpcs.combat.value.own: The NPC's own value, the same one the standard editor shows. Edit it here or there.

wolffsmodnpcs.crew.auto.help: The vehicle crews its empty seats by itself when it spawns, a clone of it included, and each time it comes back after being destroyed.
wolffsmodnpcs.crew.class.help: Short name of the Flan's class whose loadout and skin each crew member gets
wolffsmodnpcs.crew.clone_name.help: The name the clone was saved under. Each seat gets its own copy, of the vehicle's faction, staying dead once killed.
wolffsmodnpcs.crew.clone_tab.help: The clone's tab in the Custom NPCs cloner, from 1 to 15
wolffsmodnpcs.crew.crew_now.help: Crews the empty seats now with the settings shown. Needs the permissions to edit statistics and create NPCs.
wolffsmodnpcs.crew.denied: You may not change this NPC's crew.
wolffsmodnpcs.crew.destroyed.help: What happens to the crew aboard when the vehicle is destroyed. A deleted vehicle always takes its crew with it.
wolffsmodnpcs.crew.no_seats: This NPC's model has no seats to crew.
wolffsmodnpcs.crew.passengers_fire.help: Crew in seats without a gun fight with their own weapons. Drivers and gunners never do: the vehicle drives and fires by itself.
wolffsmodnpcs.crew.remove.help: Removes the crew aboard. Needs the permissions to edit statistics and delete NPCs.
wolffsmodnpcs.crew.shielded.help: The crew take no harm while aboard, and attackers aiming at them aim at the vehicle instead. Only damage that ignores invulnerability reaches them.
wolffsmodnpcs.crew.source.class: New NPC with a class loadout
wolffsmodnpcs.crew.status.clone_unnamed: Enter the name of a saved clone
wolffsmodnpcs.crew.status.no_seats: The model has no seats of this kind
wolffsmodnpcs.crew.team.help: Short name of the team whose class it is, which also gives its armour; leave empty for a class that belongs to no team
wolffsmodnpcs.editor.bad_template_id: A squad template needs an id of lower-case letters, digits, - and _
wolffsmodnpcs.editor.crew_help: A class of the team, any for one picked by the class weights, or none to leave these seats empty. Used while Vehicle crews is on.
wolffsmodnpcs.editor.rotation_changed: The rotation changed; the bot settings were not saved

wolffsmodnpcs.held_item.help: Offsets use model pixels (16 per block) in the local item display frame; rotations use degrees. Each hand is independent. Presets apply to Flan items. Custom arm axes also work with empty hands, relative to the body, and are the only override for shield poses. Shield item transforms stay fixed. Reset hand resets this tab for the selected hand.
wolffsmodnpcs.held_item.states_help: The first active state wins: using/charging, firing, living attack target, moving, idle. Server default uses normal aim rules in that state. Firing hold sets the time after a shot.

wolffsmodnpcs.hub.server.help: Settings of the whole server rather than of this NPC: target-search intervals for every NPC, the ranges of new NPCs and applying them to every NPC, profiling and benchmarks

wolffsmodnpcs.orders.commander_left: %s left the command of your side's bots
wolffsmodnpcs.orders.map_help: Click: squad = pick, objective = attack/defend, ground = hold
wolffsmodnpcs.orders.no_commander: Nobody commands your side: squads within 24 blocks hear you.
wolffsmodnpcs.orders.not_playing: You do not play a round with bots.

wolffsmodnpcs.orders.you_command: You command your side: every squad hears you.

wolffsmodnpcs.parts.armor.help: Nominal armour thickness against kinetic rounds, in millimetres. 0 leaves the part unarmoured against them. Used only with Override armour set to Yes; otherwise the model's plates apply.
wolffsmodnpcs.parts.armor_heat.help: Equivalent armour thickness against shaped-charge jets, in millimetres. Set this higher than the kinetic value for composite or spaced armour. 0 leaves the part unarmoured against HEAT. Used only with Override armour set to Yes.
wolffsmodnpcs.parts.armor_override.help: Off by default. Yes replaces every face of this part with the mm and vsHEAT values, starting from the model's front-face thicknesses, independently of the box. With No, the fields show those model values; other faces may differ. The replacement has no virtual slope; impact angle still applies. No restores the model's plates. Needs Part hitboxes, Model damage profile and Model armour.
wolffsmodnpcs.parts.corner.help: The corner of the box with the smallest coordinates, in model pixels from the model origin: X to the right, Y up, Z to the rear.
wolffsmodnpcs.parts.enabled.help: No takes the part out of the NPC: it is not hit, holds no health and cannot be broken. Taking the core out leaves an NPC that only dies once all its health is gone.
wolffsmodnpcs.parts.frame: The box turns with the hull and scales with the NPC's size.
wolffsmodnpcs.parts.frame_turret: Given with the turret at rest; the box turns with the turret.
wolffsmodnpcs.parts.health.help: Hit points of the part in the model's units. They decide how the NPC's health is shared out between its parts; the NPC's own health decides how much there is. 0 makes a part that stops rounds but cannot be broken.
wolffsmodnpcs.parts.mode.help: Model uses the part as the model defines it. Custom gives the NPC its own box, hit points and resistance for the part, starting from the model's.
wolffsmodnpcs.parts.none: The selected model has no part hitboxes.
wolffsmodnpcs.parts.reset.help: Return this part to the model's box, hit points, resistance and armour, and put it back if it was left out.
wolffsmodnpcs.parts.reset_all.help: Return every part to the model's, including parts of other models this NPC has changed.
wolffsmodnpcs.parts.resistance.help: Penetrating power a round loses passing through the part.
wolffsmodnpcs.parts.share.none: Left out: holds none of the NPC's health
wolffsmodnpcs.parts.size.help: Size of the box in model pixels along the same axes.
wolffsmodnpcs.presentation.death_rotatio: Tip the body over when killed. No keeps it upright; with Hide killed body enabled it disappears immediately. Death, loot and respawn still run normally. Selecting a Flan model resets this to No; later manual choices are saved for that model.
Audible radius: 1 to 4096 blocks. Initially uses the current server vehicle sound range.
wolffsmodnpcs.presentation.engine_repeat: 1 to 12000 ticks; 20 ticks = 1 second. Automatic Flan timing uses the selected asset length (authored length or 20 ticks if unknown). Short intervals cut off the previous clip.
wolffsmodnpcs.presentation.hide_body.hel: The same NPC setting as Hide Body When Killed. With Death rotation disabled, hide immediately; otherwise use the normal death animation delay.
wolffsmodnpcs.presentation.hint: Hover labels for help; grey ones do nothing now. Clones and presets keep it.
wolffsmodnpcs.presentation.hurt_flash.he: Show the red overlay when hurt or dying. No preserves the skin tint. Damage, invulnerability and hurt/death sounds are unchanged. Selecting a Flan model resets this to No; later manual choices are saved for that model.
Play stationary engine audio. Idle and movement replace one another; killed, silent and removed NPCs stop playing.
wolffsmodnpcs.presentation.loop_idle_ena: Repeat a sound of your own while the NPC stands still, in place of its idle sound. Idle and movement loops replace one another; killed, silent and removed NPCs stop playing. Nothing plays until a sound is chosen.
wolffsmodnpcs.presentation.loop_movement: Repeat a sound of your own while the NPC moves, in place of its step sound. Nothing plays until a sound is chosen.
wolffsmodnpcs.presentation.model_default: Use the selected Flan vehicle or plane sounds and effective ranges. No enables separate custom editors. Switching to Yes resets both sound editors to the actual vehicle defaults, clearing custom sounds, ranges and repeat overrides.
wolffsmodnpcs.presentation.model_sounds_: Open Inherit from model > Model properties > Sounds, where the model's and the NPC's own idle and step sounds are set.
wolffsmodnpcs.presentation.movement_enab: Play engine clips while moving, including reverse, flight and swimming. Independent of model properties and firing sounds.
wolffsmodnpcs.presentation.override_repe: No follows the measured Flan asset length. Yes uses a fixed interval in ticks. This toggle is hidden for non-Flan sounds; their interval is always manually configured.
wolffsmodnpcs.presentation.repeat_automa: Flan sound length; adjusted for playback pitch.
wolffsmodnpcs.presentation.repeat_manual: Fixed interval; shorter intervals cut off the previous clip.
wolffsmodnpcs.presentation.variable_pitc: Follow actual movement speed and the vehicle pitch curve. No plays at normal pitch. Automatic Flan repeats account for playback speed.
wolffsmodnpcs.presentation.vehicle_read_: Read-only: Use vehicle's defaults is Yes.

wolffsmodnpcs.preset.denied: You may not change this NPC's preset settings.

wolffsmodnpcs.preset.setting.door_intera: Opens and walks through doors instead of stopping at them
wolffsmodnpcs.preset.setting.hide_body.e: Its body is removed once it is killed
wolffsmodnpcs.preset.setting.moving_type: Walks around on its own instead of standing still
wolffsmodnpcs.preset.setting.npc_interac: Does not stop to talk with other NPCs it meets
wolffsmodnpcs.preset.setting.return_to_s: Stays where a chase or fight leaves it instead of walking back
wolffsmodnpcs.preset.setting.walking_ran: 0 means no limit: it roams from wherever it is instead of around where it was placed
wolffsmodnpcs.preset.unchanged: Nothing else is changed, such as faction, aggro range, tactic or inventory.

wolffsmodnpcs.preset.warning.hold: Tactic is Hold position (Tactics page): in a fight it keeps to where it was placed.

wolffsmodnpcs.skirmish.no_branches: Faction %s has no branch to field
wolffsmodnpcs.skirmish.no_theatre: No branch of %s serves where it comes in; all of them fight
wolffsmodnpcs.skirmish.no_war: No two sides of the skirmish are at war
wolffsmodnpcs.skirmish.not_draft: That skirmish has started already, or its dimension is not loaded
wolffsmodnpcs.skirmish.not_managed: Faction %s is not managed for battles
wolffsmodnpcs.skirmish.round_running: A Teams round is being played; skirmishes rest until it ends

wolffsmodnpcs.skirmish.too_few_sides: A skirmish needs at least two sides

wolffsmodnpcs.soldier.loadout.unknown: That team or class is not loaded on the server.
wolffsmodnpcs.sounds.off.fire_main_hand: Silent: the main-hand Flan gun plays its own shot only while Flan firing sounds is on (Weapon tab). Switch the row to Custom to play the NPC's own sound.
wolffsmodnpcs.sounds.off.fire_off_hand: Silent: the off-hand Flan gun plays its own shot only while Flan firing sounds is on (Weapon tab). Switch the row to Custom to play the NPC's own sound.
wolffsmodnpcs.sounds.off.idle: Silent loop: the idle loop or engine sound is switched off (Sounds > Idle & movement). The NPC's own idle sound plays instead.
wolffsmodnpcs.sounds.off.movement: Silent loop: the movement loop or engine sound is switched off (Sounds > Idle & movement). The NPC's own step sound plays instead.
wolffsmodnpcs.sounds.open.properties: Inherit from model > Model properties > Sounds
wolffsmodnpcs.sounds.row.block_hit.help: The sound a round from the main-hand weapon makes when it hits a block. Only an equipped weapon sets it.
wolffsmodnpcs.sounds.row.entity_hit.help: The sound a round from the main-hand weapon makes when it hits a creature. Only an equipped weapon sets it.
What the NPC's ranged attack sounds like: the main-hand gun's own shot, the model's firing sound, or the NPC's own firing sound.
wolffsmodnpcs.sounds.row.fire_off_hand.h: What the off-hand gun sounds like: its own shot, or the NPC's own firing sound, which the off hand shares with the main hand.
wolffsmodnpcs.sounds.row.idle.help: What the NPC sounds like while it stands still: a vehicle or plane's engine idle sound, otherwise the model's idle sound while the NPC inherits it, or the NPC's own.
wolffsmodnpcs.sounds.row.movement.help: What the NPC sounds like while it moves: a vehicle or plane's engine movement sound, otherwise the model's step sound while the NPC inherits it, or the NPC's own.
wolffsmodnpcs.sounds.source.item.help: The equipped item's own sound. Set it on the equipment page by switching the row to Custom.
wolffsmodnpcs.sounds.source.model.help: The selected model's sound. Switch the row to Custom on the model properties page, or Select a sound there, to use another.
wolffsmodnpcs.sounds.source.none.help: Nothing supplies this sound with the NPC's current model and equipment.
wolffsmodnpcs.sounds.source.own.help: The NPC's own sound, saved with the NPC. Open the page to choose another.

wolffsmodnpcs.tuning.active_range.help: Distance to the nearest player within which Stay active at a distance keeps the NPC simulating.
wolffsmodnpcs.tuning.aggro_range.help: The Custom NPCs aggro range, editable here up to the server's NPC tracking range. An inherited model property replaces it.
wolffsmodnpcs.tuning.aim_speed_pitch.hel: Degrees per second the gun elevates. 0 uses the speed of the model's seat.
wolffsmodnpcs.tuning.aim_speed_yaw.help: Degrees per second the turret turns. 0 uses the speed of the model's seat.
wolffsmodnpcs.tuning.align_tolerance.hel: How far the gun may be off its firing solution and still fire. The shot itself is aimed exactly.
wolffsmodnpcs.tuning.attack_altitude.hel: Height above the terrain a plane or helicopter climbs to. Below it the NPC holds its fire and keeps its target.
wolffsmodnpcs.tuning.attack_height.help: Blocks above the terrain a plane the NPC flies makes for its target at, before it dives on it.
wolffsmodnpcs.tuning.board_range.help: How far around itself an NPC that drives Flan's driveables looks for a free one to get into. One it cannot reach within 20 seconds, or finds no path to, it leaves alone for a minute.
wolffsmodnpcs.tuning.circle_radius.help: Radius a plane the NPC flies circles at where it has nowhere further to go. A plane parked within it of where the NPC would go stays parked.
wolffsmodnpcs.tuning.client_benchmark.he: Closes the editor, measures frame times and NPC drawing, and writes a report. Also /flansnpcclientbenchmark [seconds] [warmup] [label], or status, stop and mark <label>. Chat pauses measurement.
wolffsmodnpcs.tuning.corner_speed.help: Share of its speed the vehicle keeps through a right-angle corner; gentler corners slow it less.
wolffsmodnpcs.tuning.cover_radius.help: How far around itself an NPC fighting from cover looks for a spot the target cannot see into, with a place a block or two aside to fire from. Solid blocks count as cover, glass included. Larger values find more cover but cost more.
wolffsmodnpcs.tuning.cruise_height.help: Blocks above the terrain ahead a plane the NPC flies cruises and circles at.
Share of full NPC speed gained per second: 100 reaches full speed in one second. Inherit follows the vehicle model's own engine, as a player-driven one of that definition picks up speed: engine power against mass under a real-world profile, otherwise its legacy throttle response; the field shows the steady rate that reaches 90% as soon. Without a ground vehicle model, or with Use model properties off, it uses 100. Custom supplies your own fixed rate.
wolffsmodnpcs.tuning.drive_braking.help: Share of full NPC speed shed per second while braking, for corners, traffic, stops and changes of direction. Inherit follows the vehicle model's brakes and resistance at its current speed, as for a player-driven one of that definition, and the vehicle brakes early enough to make its corners and stops; the field shows the rate at top speed. Without a ground vehicle model it uses 250. Custom supplies your own fixed rate.
wolffsmodnpcs.tuning.drive_coasting.help: Share of full throttle shed per second when the vehicle has nowhere to go. Inherit follows the vehicle model's rolling resistance off the pedals, never less than the rolling resistance of its wheels or tracks; the field shows the rate at top speed. Without a ground vehicle model it uses 60. Custom supplies your own fixed rate.
wolffsmodnpcs.tuning.drive_lookahead.hel: How far ahead on its path the vehicle steers and looks for corners. It only steers past nodes while the path runs straight and level.
wolffsmodnpcs.tuning.drive_preset.help: Fills in type, acceleration, braking, coasting, turn radius, lookahead, corner speed and hull turn rate. The values stay editable; editing one switches back to Custom.
wolffsmodnpcs.tuning.drive_reverse_speed: Reverse speed as a percentage of forward speed. Inherit uses the definition's real reverse/forward speed ratio, including no reverse when prohibited; missing data uses 40%. Custom supplies your own percentage. Requires Use model properties for definition inheritance.
wolffsmodnpcs.tuning.drive_type.help: Automatic: tracked when the model is a tank, wheeled otherwise. Wheeled has to roll to turn, on its turn radius. Tracked turns on the spot. Heavy tracked stops to turn sharply and turns more slowly.
wolffsmodnpcs.tuning.fire_limit.help: Transparent blocks the NPC fires through. Whether the round gets through is up to the round.
wolffsmodnpcs.tuning.firing_range.help: The Custom NPCs ranged attack range, editable here beyond the editor's 256 blocks, up to the server's NPC tracking range. An inherited model property replaces it.
wolffsmodnpcs.tuning.flight_speed.help: Speed of a plane in tenths of a block per second. 0 keeps it between 2.6 and 8.4 blocks per second.
wolffsmodnpcs.tuning.flight_type.help: For Flying movement: Normal uses Custom NPCs flight. Plane keeps moving and circles when the wandering range is limited; with unlimited wandering and return to start off, it roams freely. Helicopter can hover. Both climb before attacking.
wolffsmodnpcs.tuning.follow_distance.hel: Distance kept to a vehicle NPC ahead; the vehicle stops at half of it. 0 ignores other vehicles.
wolffsmodnpcs.tuning.helicopter_landing_: Seconds a helicopter the NPC flies hovers with nothing to do before it lands. 0 keeps it in the air.
wolffsmodnpcs.tuning.hint: Saved per NPC. Hover labels for help; grey ones do nothing now. 0: automatic.
wolffsmodnpcs.tuning.hover_height.help: Blocks above the terrain ahead a helicopter the NPC flies flies and hovers at.
wolffsmodnpcs.tuning.hull_turn_rate.help: Hull yaw rate in degrees per second. Inherit reads the vehicle's active RealTurnRateDegPerSec (or TurnRateDegPerSec); missing data uses 90, or 54 for Heavy tracked. Custom supplies your own rate. Legacy left/right steering coefficients are not absolute rates. Requires Use model properties for definition inheritance.
wolffsmodnpcs.tuning.keep_distance.help: Distance a vehicle the NPC drives keeps to a Flan's driveable someone drives, or a vehicle NPC, ahead: it stops accelerating while it closes in within it and brakes within half of it. Behind one that stands in its way it waits 5 seconds, then drives round. 0 ignores them.
wolffsmodnpcs.tuning.land_speed.help: Approximate speed on level ground in tenths of a block per second: 45 is 4.5 blocks per second. 0 keeps the walking speed. A vehicle model that drives like a vehicle, with Use model properties on, offers Inherit instead: its definition's top speed, with the active speed scale and speed cap.
wolffsmodnpcs.tuning.low_fuel.help: Share of its tank under which an aircraft the NPC flies gives up its target and its goal, flies home, lands there and stays on the ground. No aircraft with less is taken. 0 flies on to the last drop.
wolffsmodnpcs.tuning.max_wade_depth.help: Deepest water a Ground profile paths through, from 0 to 64 blocks (default 1), checked under the whole footprint. Larger allowances can require more fluid reads during pathfinding.
wolffsmodnpcs.tuning.min_water_depth.hel: Shallowest water a Watercraft profile paths through, from 1 to 64 blocks (default 1). Every hull column must meet the minimum; one shallow column rejects the node. Larger minima can require more fluid reads during pathfinding.
wolffsmodnpcs.tuning.path_margin.help: How far beyond the distance to its goal a path search may reach. Raise it where NPCs must go round large obstacles.
wolffsmodnpcs.tuning.path_retry_interval: Ticks a pursuit keeps its path before searching again. 1 searches every tick.
wolffsmodnpcs.tuning.plane_landing_delay: Seconds a plane the NPC flies circles with nothing to do before it lands where it circles. 0 keeps it in the air.
wolffsmodnpcs.tuning.reverse_angle.help: A goal further off the hull than this counts as behind the vehicle.
wolffsmodnpcs.tuning.reverse_distance.he: A goal behind the vehicle is reached in reverse when it is no further than this.
wolffsmodnpcs.tuning.search_far_interval: Ticks between searches of the farthest band, up to 512 blocks. 0 uses the interval of the Server page. The bands in between scale from the near interval to this one.
wolffsmodnpcs.tuning.search_near_interva: Ticks between searches of the first 32 blocks. 0 uses the interval of the Server page. All NPCs search them in the same tick, so a formation reacts together. Stagger nearby searches disables this shared cadence. An active explicit band interval overrides this value.
The aggro range a newly created NPC starts with, and the one Apply ranges to every NPC hands out. NPCs that already exist keep their own until then. Operators only.
wolffsmodnpcs.tuning.server_apply_ranges: Overwrites the aggro and firing range of every NPC in the world with the two values above: loaded NPCs within a second, the others when they next load, including NPCs spawned from clones saved before. A range a model supplies keeps covering the NPC's own value. Asks for a second click. Operators only.
Click again to overwrite every NPC's ranges
Overwrites the aggro and firing range of every NPC in the world. Any other edit cancels.
wolffsmodnpcs.tuning.server_benchmark.he: Measures server ticks, NPC ticks, path searches and target searches, and writes a report. Also /flansnpcbenchmark [seconds] [warmup] [label], or status and stop. Operators only.
wolffsmodnpcs.tuning.server_far_interval: Ticks between target searches of the farthest band, for every NPC that does not set its own. Operators only.
wolffsmodnpcs.tuning.server_firing_range: The ranged attack range a newly created NPC starts with, and the one Apply ranges to every NPC hands out. NPCs that already exist keep their own until then. Operators only.
wolffsmodnpcs.tuning.server_hint: These hold for the whole server, not for this NPC. Changes apply at once.
wolffsmodnpcs.tuning.server_near_interva: Ticks between target searches of the first 32 blocks, for every NPC that does not set its own on the Performance & debug page. Operators only.
wolffsmodnpcs.tuning.server_profiling.he: Count the searches, candidates, full tests and time of each distance band and write them to the server log every ten seconds. Not saved.
wolffsmodnpcs.tuning.sight.help: Normal: vanilla line of sight. See through: sees through leaves, glass, panes, bars and fences, but only fires with a clear line and keeps closing in. See and fire through: also fires through them. The blocks are those of the wolffsmodnpcs:see_through tag.
wolffsmodnpcs.tuning.stop_distance.help: The vehicle stops this far from the end of its path. 0 drives all the way.
wolffsmodnpcs.tuning.submarine_depth.hel: Blocks below the surface a Watercraft runs at, less over shallows. It never runs out of air. 0 floats.
wolffsmodnpcs.tuning.tactic.help: How the NPC moves while it fights at range, with a ranged weapon in hand or a projectile; it keeps firing as it goes. Only the tactics for this kind of NPC are offered. Custom NPCs: the Tactical variant of the AI page. Advance: closes in to the tactic distance, running while far off. Hold position: stays where it was placed. Cover: fights from cover nearby, stepping out to fire and back in to reload or when hit; without cover it advances. Stand-off: keeps about the tactic distance, backing away when the target comes closer. Bounding advance: fires a burst, then dashes a few blocks closer. Flank: swings out to one side of the target first. Circle: drives round the target. Strafing run (planes): passes over the target firing, carries on for the tactic distance and comes round. Orbit (planes): circles the target. Strafe (helicopters): keeps its distance and slips from side to side. Within melee range the NPC fights as Custom NPCs says.
wolffsmodnpcs.tuning.tactic_distance.hel: Blocks from its target the tactic keeps the NPC at, never beyond its firing range; for a strafing run, how far the plane carries on past its target. 0 takes a share of the firing range that suits the weapon in hand: 30% for a shotgun, 85% for a scoped gun, 70% for a machine gun or launcher, 60% otherwise, at least 4 blocks.
wolffsmodnpcs.tuning.target_margin.help: Blocks beyond its aggro range at which the NPC keeps a target it already has. A Custom NPCs tactical movement always adds at least its own radius.
wolffsmodnpcs.tuning.terrain.help: Default: as any Custom NPC. Ground: avoids water deeper than the wade depth. Watercraft: only water at least the minimum depth, and floats. Amphibious: land and water alike, and floats.
wolffsmodnpcs.tuning.throttle_floor.help: Share of its speed a vehicle keeps while its hull points away from where it wants to go. 0 makes it turn on the spot.
wolffsmodnpcs.tuning.turn_radius.help: Rolling turn radius in tenths of a block. Inherit derives it from the vehicle's reference speed and absolute turn rate, with the active speed scale; otherwise it uses 3 blocks. An inherited radius stays constant; a custom or fallback radius widens with speed. Tracks can pivot, so their rolling radius is unused.
wolffsmodnpcs.tuning.vision_limit.help: Transparent blocks the NPC sees through.
wolffsmodnpcs.tuning.water_speed.help: Approximate speed in water in tenths of a block per second. Faster craft also take longer to speed up and to stop. 0 keeps the default swimming speed.
wolffsmodnpcs.tuning.aim_pose.help: Overrides the general mob aim setting for this NPC. Dynamic raises guns while firing; Always raised keeps them aimed. Server mob setting inherits entityAimPose, which defaults to Dynamic. Per-hand arm rules still apply.
wolffsmodnpcs.tuning.weapon_switch.help: What the NPC does once its main-hand gun has no ammunition left in the Projectile and inventory slots. Guns and melee: take another gun from the inventory that is loaded or has ammunition, and a melee weapon once no gun is usable. Melee only: take the hardest-hitting melee weapon. None: keep the empty gun. The gun put away takes the inventory slot of the weapon taken.
wolffsmodnpcs.war.taken: %s took ground from %s at %s %s in the war %s
wolffsmodnpcs.weapons.adaptive_path_rang: A path search reaches only as far as its goal plus the detour margin, not the whole aggro range, and a pursuit keeps its path for the retry interval. No searches as Custom NPCs does.
wolffsmodnpcs.weapons.advanced_lead.help: Lead by the target's smoothed movement over recent ticks, including a cautious acceleration estimate, instead of its speed in a single tick. Teleports and gaps start over. Lead is limited to 100 ticks of flight, 96 blocks sideways and 48 up or down. No uses the current velocity only.
Honor alternating weapon banks and AA barrels; cycle twin and quad mounts. No fires all barrels together.
wolffsmodnpcs.weapons.ammo_hint: Primary weapon + armor slots; ammunition in Projectile. Hover grey values.
wolffsmodnpcs.weapons.animated_model.hel: Turret, seat guns, recoil, wheels, tracks, propellers, rotors and mecha legs move. No draws the model at rest. Distant impostors are always at rest.
wolffsmodnpcs.weapons.armor_animations.h: Animate equipped armor with the NPC's limbs. No keeps armor in its resting pose while preserving protection and rendering.
wolffsmodnpcs.weapons.ballistic_aim.help: Compensate for projectile gravity and air drag. Indirect attacks prefer a high arc. No aims directly while retaining real projectile physics.
A broken part has been shot off: rounds and blasts pass where it was, as on a driveable. No keeps broken parts in the way, where they soak up further hits without losing anything.
wolffsmodnpcs.weapons.consume_ammo.help: Equipped Flan guns use real ammunition, and Flan throwable guns and grenades use one item per successful throw. Empty main-hand and Projectile slots refill by moving usable guns, compatible ammunition or throwables from inventory in slot order. A held gun's ammunition takes priority. No keeps Flan ammunition and throwables infinite; infinite thrown weapons cannot be picked up in survival. Needs Use equipped weapons; model weapons are not affected.
wolffsmodnpcs.weapons.doors_open.help: Draw the model with its doors open.
wolffsmodnpcs.weapons.drive_driveables.h: The NPC walks to the free driver seat of a Flan's vehicle, mecha or aircraft within its boarding range that its choice of driveables allows and no enemy of it rides, before anything else moves it, gets in and takes it wherever it would walk: to its target, along its route, back home. It looks for a way as wide and high as a vehicle or mecha, up to 3 blocks, and keeps its distance to a driveable ahead. A plane takes off, cruises at its cruise height above the terrain ahead, makes strafing runs on its target, circles where it has nowhere further to go and lands there after a while; a helicopter flies at its hover height, hovers facing its target and lands when it has nothing to do. An aircraft short of fuel flies home and lands there. The Flying tab sets the heights, the circle, the landing delays and the fuel reserve. A driveable whose tank runs dry is left once it stands on the ground, and none short of fuel is taken. It turns the turret, or a mecha's arms, to its target and fires the driveable's weapons, leading a moving target and allowing for the drop of their rounds as the Aiming page says, and drops bombs to come down on it, with the driveable's ammunition and fuel, never its own. It gets out when this is turned off, or when the driveable stays stuck, which it then leaves alone for a minute, and bails out of an aircraft about to be lost, by parachute from high up. It crews driveables too: following a player, it gets into the one its owner rides, a gun seat before a passenger seat, and gets out when its owner does; otherwise, with no driver seat free, it takes a free gun seat of one an ally drives and gets out after 5 seconds without a driver. A gunner mans its gun at its target and leaves its own weapons be; a passenger fights with its own. Aircraft that fly freely in six degrees and ships built on planes are left to players. Not for NPCs shown as a Flan model, nor for crew.
wolffsmodnpcs.weapons.drive_reverse.help: Reach a nearby goal behind the vehicle in reverse instead of turning round.
wolffsmodnpcs.weapons.driving.help: A ground vehicle gains and loses speed gradually, steers for a point ahead on its path, slows before corners and behind other vehicles, reverses to goals behind it and backs up when stuck. No keeps plain hull steering. Needs Hull follows travel.
wolffsmodnpcs.weapons.dual_wield.help: Fire a second Flan gun held in the off hand, alongside the main-hand weapon. It keeps its own cadence and reloads from the projectile slot. As for players, a two-handed gun does not fire while the other hand is full. Needs Use equipped weapons. No leaves the off hand for shields. A gun in the off hand with no ranged weapon in the main hand is always fired, as the NPC's only gun.
wolffsmodnpcs.weapons.melee_dual_wield.h: Alternate melee weapons between hands, one strike at a time on one shared cooldown. Each strike uses that weapon's damage, reach, recovery, enchantments, durability and animation. Main hand properties > Melee controls Inherit/Custom for both hands; Custom uses the NPC's shared values. Empty hands, shields and non-weapons are skipped. One usable weapon attacks alone. Needs Use equipped weapons. Default No keeps main-hand melee.
wolffsmodnpcs.weapons.engine_running.hel: Propellers and rotors turn, at idle while the NPC stands. No stops them. A killed NPC's engine always stops.
wolffsmodnpcs.weapons.eye_at_muzzle.help: The NPC looks and checks its line of sight from the height of its first muzzle instead of from its hitbox.
wolffsmodnpcs.weapons.fire_sounds.help: Play content shooting sounds for equipped Flan guns and model/template attacks. No mutes equipped Flan gunfire; model/template shots use the saved NPC firing sound. Reloads, throws, impacts and explosions are independent.
Hold fire until the gun points at its firing solution. The cooldown and the burst are not spent while waiting. A gun fixed to the hull waits for the hull to face the target.
Apply the NPC's melee resistance to Flan gun melee, and its projectile and explosion resistances to any damage tagged as such. Only matters while Use equipped armor is off, since armor then replaces the resistances. No keeps the Custom NPCs rule, which leaves Flan melee unresisted.
wolffsmodnpcs.weapons.full_throttle.help: Draw the model at full throttle, wheels and tracks turning, even while the NPC stands still.
wolffsmodnpcs.weapons.gear_up.help: Draw an aircraft with its landing gear retracted.
wolffsmodnpcs.weapons.gradual_aim.help: The turret and seat guns turn and elevate at a limited speed and stay within the model's limits. No snaps the gun onto the target within those limits.
wolffsmodnpcs.weapons.grenades.help: Throw real grenades with their content-defined fuse, bounce and explosion. No uses the normal Custom NPCs projectile for grenades.
wolffsmodnpcs.weapons.gun_melee_animatio: Play a held Flan gun's melee animation when the NPC strikes with it.
wolffsmodnpcs.weapons.gun_reload_animati: Play a held Flan gun's reload animation while the NPC reloads. Without Use equipped weapons, the pause after each Custom NPCs burst counts as the reload.
wolffsmodnpcs.weapons.gun_shot_animation: Play a held Flan gun's own shot animation when it fires: slide or pump, hammer, casing and muzzle flash model. The aiming pose is governed by Weapon animations.
wolffsmodnpcs.weapons.hitbox_outlines.he: Draw the part boxes around the NPC: yellow while a part can be hit, red once it is broken. What is drawn is what rounds hit. Flan's debug mode shows them for every NPC.
wolffsmodnpcs.weapons.hull_assists_aim.h: A vehicle that stands still turns its hull toward a target its gun cannot reach: a fixed gun, or a turret with a limited traverse.
A vehicle drives where its hull points and its hull turns toward where it wants to go at a limited rate, while the turret stays on target. An AA gun's base keeps its facing. Planes and mechas turn like any NPC.
wolffsmodnpcs.weapons.invulnerable.help: Ignore all damage. The /kill command and the void still apply.
wolffsmodnpcs.weapons.armor_potion_effec: Allow equipped Flan armor to grant potion effects, including Resistance and Regeneration. No removes armor-granted potion effects while keeping armor protection, attributes and movement bonuses. Requires Use equipped armor.
wolffsmodnpcs.weapons.item_armor.help: Armor slots govern native protection, toughness, enchantments, durability, attributes and Flan armor effects. Choose resistance by resistance in Armor properties which ones the NPC takes from its armor and which it keeps its own values for; inherited resistance controls show a read-only preview. No restores NPC armor behavior.
wolffsmodnpcs.weapons.item_weapons.help: Weapons in hand govern real attacks, including item attributes, enchantments, arrows, loaded Flan magazines, throwing and shield use. A ranged weapon in the main hand comes first; with none there, a Flan gun in the off hand is fired instead. The projectile slot supplies ammunition. Choose statistic by statistic in Main hand properties and Off hand properties which ones the NPC takes from its weapons and which it keeps its own values for. No restores NPC attacks.
wolffsmodnpcs.weapons.lead_target.help: Aim ahead of a moving target by the round's flight time.
wolffsmodnpcs.weapons.manned_guns_fire.h: A seat gun a crew member mans fires at the NPC's target once it points there within its limits, the target is within firing range and nothing solid is in the way. It fires its gun's default ammunition, at the gun's own cadence and reload, without using any up.
wolffsmodnpcs.weapons.melee_sounds.help: Play the held Flan gun's melee sound when the NPC strikes with it.
wolffsmodnpcs.weapons.misaligned_throttl: A vehicle whose hull points more than 20 degrees away from where it wants to go slows down, to its slowest at 90 degrees or more.
wolffsmodnpcs.weapons.model_armour.help: Resolve kinetic rounds and shaped charges against the selected vehicle's armour. With Part hitboxes, a round meets the armour of the part and face it strikes, and blasts are weighed against the plate of each part they reach. Without them every hit meets the hull armour, on the side the shot strikes as seen from where the NPC faces. Armour that stops a round leaves the NPC unhurt. Needs Model damage profile. No lets every round through at its full damage.
wolffsmodnpcs.weapons.model_culling.help: The client hides the NPC only when its whole model is out of view, not just its hitbox. Keeps long ships and wide aircraft from vanishing at the screen edge.
wolffsmodnpcs.weapons.model_muzzles.help: Launch from the selected Flan model's weapon positions, including NPC size and AA barrels. No launches from eye height.
wolffsmodnpcs.weapons.model_sounds.help: Inherit model idle and footstep audio while Use model properties is enabled. Vehicles and planes use their engine sounds instead (Sounds > Idle & movement).
wolffsmodnpcs.weapons.model_weapon_stats: Fire the selected model's weapons with their own damage, spread, speed and pellet count: its mounted guns, AA barrels or vehicle banks. No fires them with the NPC's own ranged values. Each value can also be kept or imported one by one in Model properties > Weapon. Only reads the model: held and equipped items are set under Equipment. Ammunition ballistics always apply.
Throw splash and lingering potions, experience bottles, eggs, firework rockets and fire charges from the projectile slot as the real thing: potions splash, fireworks explode and fire charges ignite. NPC accuracy, shot count and indirect fire still apply; NPC strength does not. Projectile slot properties offers a speed override with the exact item speed as its inherited/imported default. No uses the Custom NPCs projectile, which only carries the item's picture.
wolffsmodnpcs.weapons.part_effects.help: A broken turret or barrel silences the gun and stops the turret. One broken track halves the speed and both stop the vehicle; broken wheels, engine rooms, boilers, bow and stern slow it down; a mecha without hips stands still and without arms cannot fire. An aircraft that loses a wing, its tail, its rotor or its airframe is shot down. Needs Part health.
wolffsmodnpcs.weapons.part_health.help: Each part holds the share of the NPC's health that its hit points are of all parts together. A hit takes health from the part it struck and no more than that part has left, and the NPC dies with its core. Damage that names no part, such as melee or fire, goes to the core. No makes every part hit take the NPC's health directly. Needs Part hitboxes.
wolffsmodnpcs.weapons.part_hitboxes.help: Flan rounds and explosions hit the part boxes of the selected vehicle, plane or mecha, turned with the hull and the turret, as they hit the real driveable. A round meets the armour of the part and face it strikes, and a blast is shared out between the parts it reaches. No goes back to the NPC's own hitbox. Melee, vanilla projectiles and clicks always use the NPC's hitbox. Models without part boxes and AA guns are unaffected.
wolffsmodnpcs.weapons.part_repair.help: Health the NPC regains is shared out among its damaged parts, broken ones included, which come back. No leaves broken parts off until the NPC respawns, and their share of the health out of reach.
wolffsmodnpcs.weapons.passenger_guns.hel: Seat guns of the model turn toward the target on their own, within each seat's limits. They fire only where a crew member mans the seat and Manned guns fire is Yes. A mecha's arms follow its aim with the turret settings.
wolffsmodnpcs.weapons.path_debug.help: Show the remaining path as red dust, the steering target as green sparks and the path end as a flame, and write the NPC's movement state to the server log once a second. At the controls of a Flan's driveable, the sparks mark the point it steers or flies for, and the log adds what it does there: the keys it holds and, flying, its phase with the pitch, bank, heading and throttle it wants against what it has. Getting in, getting out and giving up a driveable are logged too.
wolffsmodnpcs.weapons.progressive_search: Look for targets in distance bands: nearby often and together with other NPCs, farther out more rarely, nearest candidates first. No tests everything in aggro range on every search.
wolffsmodnpcs.weapons.projectiles.help: Fire real Flan bullets and grenades from the projectile slot. No restores the normal Custom NPCs projectile.
wolffsmodnpcs.weapons.read_only.ammuniti: Controlled by the Flan ammunition while Wolff's Mod > Projectiles > Flan projectiles is enabled. This saved NPC value is inactive. Disable Flan projectiles, or Flan grenades for grenade ammunition, to restore the ordinary projectile controls.
Flan rounds keep their launch speed apart from the ammunition's air drag. They never accelerate.
Flan rounds handle their own impacts and play the ammunition's hit sound or the struck block's material sound instead of this sound.
Every round of this ammunition sets its own damage: grenades use their definition and kinetic rounds compute it from mass and impact velocity. NPC strength is not used.
Flan rounds never apply this Custom NPCs effect. Potion and fire effects come only from the ammunition definition.
Flan rounds never apply the Custom NPCs effect, so its strength is not used. Ammunition effects use their own levels.
Flan rounds never apply the Custom NPCs effect, so its duration is not used. Ammunition effects use their own durations.
Flan rounds handle their own impacts and play the ammunition's entity hit sound instead of this sound.
Explosions use the ammunition's own radius, block damage and effects instead of this size preset.
Rounds render with the ammunition's Flan model and texture. This glow setting is not used.
Rounds drop according to the ammunition's own gravity. With Gravity compensation enabled, the NPC aims to allow for that drop.
Flan rounds push targets with the ammunition's own knockback on impact. NPC knockback is not applied.
Rounds render with the ammunition's Flan model instead of a 2D or 3D Custom NPCs item.
Disable Wolff's Mod > Projectiles > Flan projectiles (Flan grenades for grenade ammunition), or load non-Flan ammunition, to use your NPC setting again.
Flan rounds use the ammunition's own hitbox and hit detection. NPC projectile size is not used.
Every round of this ammunition declares its own launch velocity. NPC speed is not used.
Rounds orient themselves as the ammunition's model defines, usually along their flight path. Custom NPCs spin is not used.
On impact, the ammunition's own behavior applies: penetration, bouncing, sticking, exploding or despawning. Custom NPCs sticking is not used.
Rounds show the ammunition's own trail particles and smoke. This Custom NPCs trail is not spawned.
wolffsmodnpcs.weapons.read_only.firing_s: Controlled by Wolff's Mod > Sounds > Weapon. This is your saved NPC sound. Disable Flan firing sounds (or Flan throw sounds for grenades) to use it again.
Each volley plays the Flan weapon's own shooting sound once, with its configured range, instead of this sound.
Disable the matching Flan firing sounds or Flan throw sounds toggle in Wolff's Mod > Sounds > Weapon to use the saved NPC sound shown here.
wolffsmodnpcs.weapons.read_only.item_arm: Controlled by Wolff's Mod > Equipment > Use equipped armor. Native equipment, enchantments and Flan armor effects provide this protection; the saved NPC value is inactive. Percentage sliders preview a ten-HP hit because armor is nonlinear. Flan bullet defense applies to projectile hits while the projectile resistance is inherited.
A worn Flan armor piece with water breathing keeps the NPC's air supply full, so it cannot drown.
Protection against an explosion from armor points, toughness, Protection and Blast Protection enchantments and Flan armor defense, previewed at 10 HP because armor is nonlinear.
A worn Flan armor piece with fire resistance makes the NPC immune to fire and lava damage.
Knockback resistance from the worn armor's attributes. The NPC knockback resistance is ignored.
Protection against a melee hit from armor points, toughness, Protection enchantments and Flan armor defense, previewed at 10 HP because armor is nonlinear.
A worn Flan armor piece that negates fall damage protects the NPC from all fall damage.

Protection against an arrow hit from armor points, toughness, Protection enchantments and Flan armor defense, previewed at 10 HP because armor is nonlinear. Flan bullets resolve bullet defense separately.
Switch this resistance to Custom in Wolff's Mod > Equipment > Armor properties, or disable Use equipped armor, to restore your NPC setting.
wolffsmodnpcs.weapons.read_only.item_wea: Controlled by Wolff's Mod > Equipment > Use equipped weapons. The item executes its real attack; these readouts are display only. Damage previews use a generic target and loaded ammunition; impacts may vary by target or belt round. Delay includes native charging. Projectile knockback is the share of vanilla knockback kept and size is the hitbox in blocks. Values the item cannot report show Item behavior.
Item projectiles only lose speed to air drag; they never accelerate.
The item shoots with its own spread: the Flan gun's spread with attachments, or vanilla inaccuracy. Shown as 100 - spread x 5.
The aiming pose follows the held item. Shown as Yes while Wolff's Mod > Animations > Weapon animations is enabled.
Block impacts sound like the item's projectile: Flan ammunition or the struck block's material, or the vanilla arrow and trident sounds.
Items fire one shot per cycle at their own cadence instead of Custom NPCs bursts.
The item's shot delay. Automatic Flan guns keep firing at this rate while the target stays in range and sight.

Damage of the item's own projectile against a generic target with the loaded ammunition: Flan gun and ammunition damage, or vanilla arrow and trident damage with Power. Real hits may differ by target or belt round.
Item attacks never apply this Custom NPCs effect. Effects come from the item itself: tipped arrows, splash potions, Flame or Flan ammunition.
Item attacks never apply the Custom NPCs effect, so its strength is not used.
Item attacks never apply the Custom NPCs effect, so it shows 0. Item effects use their own durations.
Entity hits sound like the item's projectile: the Flan ammunition's hit sound, or the vanilla arrow and trident sounds.
The preset nearest the projectile's real explosion radius (small below 2 blocks, medium below 4, large above). The real radius is used.
The item plays its own shooting sound. Flan guns play theirs only while Wolff's Mod > Sounds > Weapon > Flan firing sounds is enabled; thrown Flan weapons use Flan throw sounds.
The item's real projectile renders with its own model and lighting. This glow setting is not used.
Shows whether the item's projectile drops. Gravity compensation aims to allow for that drop.
Items always fire directly at the target, never in a high arc. Gravity compensation still allows for projectile drop.
Share of vanilla knockback the item's projectile keeps (1x is vanilla). Punch still adds to arrows.
Equal to the minimum delay: the item's shot delay plus any draw or charge time.
The item's attack damage plus its enchantment bonus against a generic target. Smite and Bane of Arthropods add their bonus against matching mobs.
Ticks between hits: the Flan weapon's melee time, or the time derived from the item's attack speed.

Hits apply the item's own effects as for a player: Fire Aspect sets targets on fire, and other enchantments and item hit effects run. Shown as fire when Fire Aspect is present. Switch Melee effect to Custom to apply your NPC effect instead.
While the item's effects are used, the Custom NPCs effect and its strength are not.
Burn time in seconds from Fire Aspect, 4 per level.
The item's attack knockback plus its Knockback enchantment level.
The item's entity reach attribute in blocks, 3 by default.
The item's own cadence: its shot delay plus any draw or charge time (bow draw, crossbow charge, grenade throw). Flan guns also reload with their own reload time.
The item's real projectile renders with its own model instead of a 2D or 3D Custom NPCs item.

Switch this statistic to Custom in Wolff's Mod > Equipment > Main hand properties (Off hand properties for an off-hand gun), disable Use equipped weapons, or empty the hand, to use your saved NPC value again.
Projectiles per shot come from the item: the Flan gun's pellets, or three for a Multishot crossbow.
Hitbox width of the item's projectile in blocks.
Launch speed of the item's projectile in blocks per tick x 10.
The item's real projectile orients itself as it normally would. Custom NPCs spin is not used.
The item's real projectile keeps its own impact behavior; arrows and tridents stick as usual. Custom NPCs sticking is not used.
The item fires its real projectile with its own trail particles. This Custom NPCs trail is not spawned.
wolffsmodnpcs.weapons.read_only.model_we: Controlled by Wolff's Mod > Inherit from model > Model weapon stats. This is your saved NPC fallback, not the value the model's weapon fires with.
Shots use the spread of the selected model's weapon: its mounted gun or the model itself. The grey number is only your saved NPC accuracy.
Each round deals the model weapon's damage, modified by the ammunition as when a player fires it. The grey number is only your saved NPC strength.
Switch the property to Custom in Wolff's Mod > Inherit from model > Model properties, or disable Model weapon stats, to use the saved NPC value shown here.
Rounds leave at the model weapon's muzzle velocity. The grey number is only your saved NPC speed.
wolffsmodnpcs.weapons.read_only.notice: Grey values: controlled by equipment or Flan definitions.
wolffsmodnpcs.weapons.read_only.notice.h: Hover a grey control for its source. Inherited model properties display converted type values. Other overridden controls retain their inactive NPC fallback. Saved NPC defaults are preserved.
wolffsmodnpcs.weapons.read_only.type_pro: Read from the selected Flan model type through Wolff's Mod > Inherit from model > Use model properties, converted to Custom NPCs units and limits. Weapon fields are defaults before ammunition modifies them. To use your own value, switch the property to Custom or import it in Wolff's Mod > Inherit from model > Model properties, or disable inheritance altogether. Native shot count is one trigger; Flan supplies barrels and pellets.
Converted from the model weapon's spread as 100 - spread x 5. Mounts with different spreads are listed separated by /.
Aggro range is the model's targeting radius in blocks (1 to 512).

With Reload cycle and Flan ammunition, the triggers one magazine lasts: the ammunition's rounds per item, spread over the barrels the model fires together or limited by its declared reload rounds. Otherwise 1, because each trigger already fires every barrel of the bank.
The selected weapon bank's firing interval in ticks, between the triggers of one magazine.
A Flan model is a machine and has no air to run out of, so it cannot drown. A flooded engine is handled by the model's own underwater rules.
A Flan model does not heal in combat: lost hit points come back only through part repair.
The model weapon's damage, including the platform's damage multiplier, before ammunition modifies it. Mounts with different values are listed separated by /.
The selected weapon bank's shooting sound. Mounts with different sounds are listed separated by /.
Maximum health is the model's total hull HP, including health scaling. When the model changes, current health keeps the same percentage.
A Flan model does not heal by itself: lost hit points come back only through part repair.
The model's declared idle sound.
A Flan model is a machine: cobwebs do not slow it down.
Equal to the minimum delay: the model's reload time with Reload cycle and Flan ammunition, otherwise the weapon bank's firing interval.
Melee reach is the mecha's reach in blocks.

With Reload cycle and Flan ammunition, the model's reload time in ticks, waited after each magazine. Otherwise the selected weapon bank's firing interval, with fractional intervals carried between shots.
Set from whether the model's fall damage is enabled.
A Flan model is a machine: potion effects do not affect it.
Firing range is the model's targeting radius in blocks, capped at 256.
Switch this property to Custom in Wolff's Mod > Inherit from model > Model properties, or disable Use model properties, to use your saved NPC value, which is kept unchanged.
With Flan ammunition this is 1, because each trigger already fires every barrel and pellet of the bank. With other ammunition it is the weapon's pellets per trigger (1 to 10).
The model weapon's muzzle velocity in blocks per tick x 10. Mounts with different values are listed separated by /.
The model's engine sound, or the mecha's stomp sound, plays while the NPC moves.
The mecha's unloaded walking speed with a unit-speed engine, converted from blocks per tick (x 20, 0 to 100).
wolffsmodnpcs.weapons.reload_cycle.help: With Flan ammunition, a model weapon fires its magazine, then reloads for the model's reload time, as the placed AA gun or vehicle does. The magazine follows the ammunition's rounds per item, barrels and declared reload rounds. Reload and chambering sounds follow Flan reload sounds. No fires continuously at the weapon's firing interval.
wolffsmodnpcs.weapons.reload_sounds.help: Play the equipped Flan gun's reload sound, and the model's reload and chambering sounds while Reload cycle is enabled. Reload timing and ammunition loading are unchanged.
wolffsmodnpcs.weapons.rider_at_seat.help: Entities riding the NPC sit in the model's seats, the driver seat first, as many as it has, turning with the turret where a seat is on it. No uses the NPC's mount point. Crew always sit in their seats.
wolffsmodnpcs.weapons.secondary_bank.hel: Use the model's secondary weapon positions, statistics, sounds and particles. No uses its primary weapon. Driver guns alongside main weapon can also fire gun mounts in the other bank.
wolffsmodnpcs.weapons.driver_guns.help: Also fire driver-controlled gun mounts in the other weapon bank and a separate driver-seat gun, at their own cadence and reload. Enabled by default and by vehicle presets. Each driver gun uses compatible ammunition from the projectile slot, then inventory order, then its default ammunition. Ammunition is not consumed. Requires Flan projectiles and model muzzles. The selected main weapon keeps its normal attack timing.
wolffsmodnpcs.weapons.muzzle_flashes.hel: Render mounted gun muzzle flashes using the gun's FlashModel or MuzzleFlashModel and the vehicle's DefaultFlash fallback. Enabled by default, independently of shooting particles.
wolffsmodnpcs.weapons.shoot_particles.he: Emit the selected bank's authored muzzle particles, with a small flame when none are defined. Projectile trails and explosions retain their definitions.
wolffsmodnpcs.weapons.solid_hitboxes.hel: Players and other entities collide with the part boxes as with a real driveable's hull: they walk into them, stand on them and are carried along as the NPC moves and turns, so a ship's deck can be walked on. The NPC itself, its riders and its mount pass through, and it still moves and finds its way by its own hitbox. Broken parts are solid only while they still stop rounds. No lets everything pass through the model. Needs Part hitboxes.
wolffsmodnpcs.weapons.stay_active.help: Keep simulating while a player is within the active range, even beyond the server's simulation distance. Each such NPC keeps its chunk ticking: use it for the NPCs of a battle, not for everything.
wolffsmodnpcs.weapons.throw_sounds.help: Play grenade and throwable Flan weapon launch sounds. No mutes equipped Flan throws; template grenade attacks use the saved NPC firing sound. Impacts and explosions are unchanged.
wolffsmodnpcs.weapons.turret_locked.help: Freeze the turret and seat guns where they are. With Fire only when aligned the NPC then fires only at what crosses its sights.
wolffsmodnpcs.weapons.turret_muzzles.hel: Shots and shooting particles leave from where the turret or AA gun currently points. No fires from the barrel's rest position. Needs Model muzzles.
wolffsmodnpcs.weapons.type_properties.he: Read supported properties from the selected AA gun, mecha, plane or vehicle type. Show inherited values read-only in the standard editor. No restores saved NPC defaults. Weapon statistics and sounds also respect their separate switches.
wolffsmodnpcs.weapons.vehicle_damage.hel: Take Flan bullets, grenades and explosions as the selected model would: damage against planes for a plane, against vehicles for a vehicle or mecha, and base damage for an AA gun. No takes damage against living entities. NPCs without a Flan model are unaffected.
Show equipped weapon aiming, charging, blocking and shooting poses. No suppresses added equipment poses without changing real attacks or shield protection.
wolffsmodnpcs.weapons.wings_folded.help: Draw variable or folding wings in their second position.

wolffsmodnpcs.presentation.keep_wreck.he: Keep the visible body indefinitely when respawning is off. Weapons and engines stop on death. Hide body takes precedence.
wolffsmodnpcs.preset.undo.help: Restore only settings changed by the last preset. Available while this NPC remains loaded.
